About The National Assembly: Article 95 of the Constitution establishes that the National Assembly shall consist of the following:-
About The National Assembly: Two hundred and ninety members, each elected by the registered voters of single member constituencies;
About The National Assembly: Forty-seven women, each elected by the registered voters of the counties, each county constituting a single member constituency;

About The National Assembly: Twelve members nominated by parliamentary political parties according to their proportion of members of the National Assembly in accordance with Article 90, to represent special interests including the youth, persons with disabilities and workers; and
About The National Assembly: The Speaker, who is an ex officio member.
